Both are referrals, not rules: the derivations are proven, the authoring is deliberately left to the owning lane per the cross-fleet ownership discipline. The CN negative was an artifact of the search, not a property of the function. Owner this run: lane WF (work_claim.combined-stage.20260901.v1 scopes game/world/camera via camera_mode_level).

SWEEP CONTEXT so the yield is not over-read: 14 of the 39 screens-1-3 survivors derive to residual 0 under the fixed pair, and 11 of those 14 are already-shipped rules re-deriving as canaries. The three genuinely new closures are these two plus game/shop/shop::show_piles, which was unowned and IS authored this run (attempt.CH_show-piles-composed-close.20260901.v1).

PROCEDURAL NOTE WORTH CARRYING. Run-25's sweep script SKIPPED owned TUs outright, so its printed output could not serve as a census -- an exclusion made for authoring reasons silently became a measurement gap, and show_piles sat inside it. Measurement is free and ownership bars only AUTHORING: derive everywhere and TAG ownership. This pass does that, which is why two of the three new closures are referrals rather than absences.
